ContactFaq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Quote Requests
ContactFaq.subtitle: What to send, file formats, quantities and trial samples.

0.question: 1. What information do I need to send for a quote?
0.answer: Send a sample, photo or drawing; the substrate material (ABS plastic, ABS/PC or metal); the required plating; thickness, color and gloss if any; test requirements (thickness measurement, NSS/CASS salt spray); quantity per lot and schedule. HANIN engineers will ask for more if needed, then quote.

1.question: 2. What file formats can I send?
1.answer: The quote form accepts PDF, DWG, DXF, STEP, ZIP, JPG, PNG, up to 5 files, 50 MB each. For larger files, please send a download link to huyvinh82@gmail.com.

2.question: 3. How are the information and drawings I send handled?
2.answer: Drawings and attachments go only to the staff in charge of quoting and engineering and are not shared with third parties. See the Privacy Policy for details.

3.question: 4. What is the minimum order quantity?
3.answer: The minimum quantity depends on the part type and plating technology. Please contact us so HANIN can advise on each product.

4.question: 5. Does HANIN accept trial sample plating?
4.answer: Please contact us to discuss trial samples for a specific product. HANIN has a plating thickness gauge and NSS and CASS salt spray chambers to test on request.

ContactHero.description: HANIN accepts nickel-chrome plating on ABS and ABS/PC and metal plating (nickel, zinc, copper, tin, black manganese phosphating), plus painting, printing and PVD, for manufacturers of automobiles, home appliances, sanitary ware and kitchen equipment.
